record.bible_text: O come<WH03212><WTH8798>, let us sing<WH07442><WTH8762> unto the LORD<WH03068>: let us make a joyful noise<WH07321><WTH8686> to the rock<WH06697> of our salvation<WH03468>.

Forty<WH0705> years<WH08141> long was I grieved<WH06962><WTH8799> with <FI>this<Fi> generation<WH01755>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, It <FI>is<Fi> a people<WH05971> that do err<WH08582><WTH8802> in their heart<WH03824>, and they have not known<WH03045><WTH8804> my ways<WH01870>:
